definitions: If a ship goes down, it sinks.
If a price, level, or temperature goes down, it becomes lower.
If a road or path goes down, it leads from a higher to a lower place.
If a food or drink goes down, you are able to swallow it.
If a historical event or a fact goes down in a particular way, it is recorded or remembered in that way.
If a computer system goes down, it stops working temporarily.
If a person goes down, they fall to the ground.
If the sun goes down, it sets.
examples: The ship went down in a storm.
The price of petrol has gone down recently.
The path goes down to the river.
The medicine was so bitter, it wouldn't go down.
It will go down in history as a day of infamy.
The network went down for several hours.
He went down with a punch to the jaw.
We watched the sun go down over the sea.
